name: DORU-Din
main_effect: [Main] If you have a Digimon with [Dorugoramon] in its name, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers with a play cost of 4 or less. Then, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest play cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
